provenance.scope: All direct Wander cards and source grant variant; native scratch patch not integrated.

subrules.name: 702.215a
subrules.rule: Wander appears on some permanent cards. “Wander (cost)” means “You may cast this permanent from the battlefield for (cost).” Casting a spell using its wander ability follows the rules for paying alternative costs in rules 601.2b and 601.2f–h.

mechanics.original_reminder: You may cast this from the battlefield for its wander cost.
mechanics.executable_reminder: You may cast this spell from the battlefield for {Cost} rather than pay its mana cost.

semantic_equivalence.evidence: 702.215a calls for an actual cast of same permanent from battlefield for alternative price, with ordinary casting timing. Generic FromZone permission plus live current-ability gate and normal proposal transition; neither blink nor ETB-only approximation.
